revenue_growth_yoy.notes: Latest-quarter YoY growth computed from SEC Q3 revenue facts. Latest quarter: Single-quarter SEC fact. Prior-year quarter: Single-quarter SEC fact. Q2/Q3 single-quarter values may be derived from year-to-date 10-Q/6-K facts; Q4 may be derived from annual facts minus Q3 year-to-date facts.

revenue_cagr_3y.notes: Latest-quarter 3-year CAGR computed from SEC Q3 revenue facts. Latest quarter: Single-quarter SEC fact. Prior-year quarter: Single-quarter SEC fact. Q2/Q3 single-quarter values may be derived from year-to-date 10-Q/6-K facts; Q4 may be derived from annual facts minus Q3 year-to-date facts.

eps_growth_yoy.notes: Latest-quarter diluted EPS YoY growth computed from comparable SEC quarterly diluted EPS facts.

eps_cagr_3y.notes: Latest-quarter diluted EPS 3-year CAGR computed from comparable SEC quarterly diluted EPS facts.

free_cash_flow.notes: Latest-quarter free_cash_flow: Quarterly free cash flow computed as operating cash flow minus capex.

roe.notes: Latest-quarter roe: Annualized quarterly net income divided by quarter-end equity.

roic.notes: Latest-quarter roic: Proxy annualized quarterly ROIC: operating income divided by quarter-end invested capital. No tax adjustment is applied.

cash.notes: Latest SEC cash or cash-and-equivalent balance fact.

debt.notes: Debt computed as sum of SEC debt components: LongTermDebtCurrent, LongTermDebtNoncurrent.

debt_to_equity.notes: Latest debt divided by latest stockholders' equity.

fcf_margin.notes: Free cash flow TTM divided by revenue TTM, expressed as a percentage.

pe.notes: Market cap divided by net income TTM.
